differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned closer to the JUSPAY tile, creating a tighter crop.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned further back, showing more of the surrounding layout.
differences.fix: Adjust camera distance and focal length to match the reference framing.

differences.a_observable: Stronger vignetting is visible, darkening the corners of the frame.
differences.b_observable: The corners are bright, indicating a lack of vignette falloff.
differences.fix: Apply a stronger vignette effect in post-processing.

differences.a_observable: Deep shadows are present in the tile recesses, creating high contrast.
differences.b_observable: The shadows are washed out and grey, resulting in lower contrast.
differences.fix: Adjust the luma curve to deepen the shadows and blacks.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust camera position and zoom to match the reference framing, and deepen the shadows to restore contrast.
